user_story:
As a user, I want to be able to add and remove elements dynamically from the page so that I can test the functionality of adding and removing elements in a web application.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. When I click the button with the text 'Add Element', a new element is added to the page.
2. The added elements should be visible in the div with id 'elements'.
3. I should be able to click on the added elements to remove them.
4. The URL should remain the same during these actions.
